200.description: Event page, including an empty page with a reusable cursor.

id.description: Stable event identity, also usable as a cursor and deduplication key.

occurred_at.description: Source operation time, stored once when the event is created.

event.description:
submitted means the log entered this contest. updated means its
contest-visible log fields changed while it remained submitted.
withdrawn means it left this contest, including deletion or moderation.

next_cursor.description: Last returned event ID, the input event ID on an empty poll, or 0 before any event.

has_more.description: More visible events existed beyond this page at the time of the read.

400.description: Invalid limit, UUID or cursor; unknown event or event from another contest or tenant.

404.description: Contest does not exist or was deleted.
